items.title: No “is” in the present
items.note: Russian drops am / is / are in the present tense. «Я студент» is simply “I (am a) student”, and «Это мой дом» is “This (is) my house”.

items.title: The object: accusative
items.note: The thing or person you act on goes into the accusative. Feminine -а → -у and -я → -ю: мама → «Я люблю маму». Masculine things and neuter nouns don’t change; masculine people take -а: «Я вижу брата».
